name: Court ceasefire ruling on the 15 km Japan map: the Ashikaga human petitions through EXECUTE_SCRIPT, pays Favor/Gold/Legitimacy, the ruling is decided at the next turn start, and a war inside a truce is undone

steps.code: local ok,res=pcall(function() local function ty(o,n) if o==nil then return 'noobj' end local k,v=pcall(function() return o[n] end) return k and type(v) or 'err' end; local p=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()[1]; local k,d=pcall(function() return p:GetDiplomacy() end); if not k then d=nil end; local out={}; for _,n in ipairs({'GetFavor','ChangeFavor','GetFavorPerTurn','AttachModifierByID'}) do out[#out+1]='Player.'..n..'='..ty(p,n) end; for _,n in ipairs({'GetFavor','ChangeFavor','GetFavorPerTurn','CalcFavorPerTurnFromAlliances'}) do out[#out+1]='Diplomacy.'..n..'='..ty(d,n) end; return table.concat(out,' ') end); return ok and res or ('probe failed: '..tostring(res))

Player.ChangeFavor='..type(p.ChangeFavor)..' Diplomacy.GetFavor='..type(d.GetFavor)..' Diplomacy.ChangeFavor='..type(d.ChangeFavor); if type(d.GetFavor)~='function' or type(d.ChangeFavor)~='function' then error('gameplay favor API missing: '..api) end; local f0=R.Favor(ashikaga); d:ChangeFavor(50); if R.Favor(ashikaga)~=f0+50 then error('ChangeFavor had no effect: '..f0..' -> '..R.Favor(ashikaga)..' ('..api..')') end; p:GetTreasury():ChangeGoldBalance(200); Game:SetProperty('JAC_ARB_TEST_BASE',{favor=R.Favor(ashikaga),gold=p:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance()}); local ok,reason=R.CheckRequest(ashikaga,ouchi,otomo); if not ok then error('Ashikaga cannot request: '..tostring(reason)) end; return 'gameplay GetDiplomacy():ChangeFavor works; '..api..'; favor='..R.Favor(ashikaga)..' gold='..p:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance()..' ouchi='..ouchi..' otomo='..otomo

local function find(civ) for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()==civ then return p:GetID() end end error(civ..' absent') end; local ouchi,otomo,ashikaga=find('CIVILIZATION_JAC_OUCHI'),find('CIVILIZATION_JAC_OTOMO'),find('CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHIKAGA'); local x,y=find('CIVILIZATION_JAC_CHOSOKABE'),find('CIVILIZATION_JAC_AINU'); local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_CourtArbitration; if not R then error('arbitration script not loaded') end; local turn=R.GameTurn(); if turn~=2 then error('elapsed turn '..turn) end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_PENDING')~=nil then error('request not resolved') end; if Players[x]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(y) then error('truce not reimposed (MakePeaceWith)') end; local war=Players[ouchi]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(otomo); local truce=Game:GetProperty(R.TruceKey(ouchi,otomo)); if not war then if truce~=32 then error('accepted but truce='..tostring(truce)) end; return 'accepted: Ouchi-Otomo at peace until turn 32 (3x); test truce reimposed' end; if truce~=nil then error('refused but a truce was set') end; local refusers={}; for _,id in ipairs({ouchi,otomo}) do if Players[id]:GetProperty('JAC_LEGITIMACY')==35 and Players[id]:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_OUTLAW_UNTIL')==12 then table.insert(refusers,tostring(id)) end end; if #refusers==0 then error('refused but no refuser penalized') end; return 'refused by '..table.concat(refusers,',')..' (legitimacy 35, outlaw until 12); test truce reimposed'
